items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered a sprained MCL vs Titans and is expected to miss a few weeks, per Schefter and Rapoport.
items.why: Sprained MCL confirmed by tests Monday; sources to Schefter/RapSheet.
items.implication: Multi-week absence opens targets behind DeVonta Smith; Mundt/Jenkins next up but low fantasy upside.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson says Caleb Williams is week-to-week with hamstring injury suffered Sunday; underwent MRI Monday and will miss some time. Tyson Bagent is the backup.
items.why: Hamstring on scramble; coach radio comments + MRI; walking postgame but miss time expected.
items.implication: Bagent likely starts Week 3 vs Eagles; limited downgrade to Bears skill if scheme holds.
items.opportunity: Monitor Bagent for superflex; Rome Odunze/D'Andre Swift volume stable

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated left elbow (same as last year), X-rays negative no fracture; out Week 3 vs Seahawks, imaging Monday, specialists Tue/Wed, expected to miss time. Marcus Mariota starts.
items.why: Dislocation on non-contact stumble; prior history missed ~month; Quinn confirms miss time.
items.implication: Mariota start devalues Commanders pass catchers short-term; timeline TBD after specialists.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE; RJ Harvey inactive. Grab Jonah Coleman if ignored preseason.
items.implication: McConkey plays through rib; Harvey out elevates Coleman handcuff/stash.

items.text: Chargers placing TEs David Njoku (fibula) and Charlie Kolar (forearm) on injured reserve.
items.why: Schefter report after both left early (Njoku 11 snaps knee/fibula, Kolar 42 forearm).
items.implication: Clears path for Oronde Gadsden (29 snaps/15 routes in game).
items.opportunity: Gadsden TE upside spike with Herbert

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through two weeks opportunities Bucky 36 vs Gainwell 12. Sean Tucker active but 0 offensive snaps.
items.implication: Clear lead back role solidifying; Gainwell diminished.
items.opportunity: Bucky every-down upside; handcuff Gainwell less valuable

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in last 31 games) and was punished with playing time. NE offense needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out. Even split on touches makes sense.
items.why: Fumble punishment + AJ Brown absence creates need for Henderson.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion; Stevenson risk elevated.
items.opportunity: Henderson more touches/routes while Brown out

items.text: DeVonta Smith target shares 27% and 38% first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points. RIDE OR DIE.
items.why: High target share + expected points model; amplified by Goedert absence.
items.implication: Must-start WR1 with clear alpha role in PHI offense.
items.opportunity: Target volume spike with Goedert out

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI after stinger suffered Sunday but hope is minor; he played through it.
items.why: Stinger in first half, played through; GMFB/Rap report.

items.text: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan said Mike Evans’ hip injury not believed serious; could have returned in fourth quarter if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.
items.implication: Evans likely available Week 3; Robinson more concerning.

items.text: Sunday FantasyFootball injuries watching: Caleb Williams (ham), Jayden Daniels (elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jadarian Price (chest), Jayden Reed (head), Jonathon Brooks (groin), Rico Dowdle (toe), Aaron Jones (knee), JK Dobbins (ham), Dallas Goedert (knee), Mike Evans (hip not serious), etc.
items.implication: Long list of status checks heading into Week 3; prioritize confirmed multi-week (Goedert, Daniels, Williams).

items.text: ETR weekend summary: GTD Ladd McConkey (cracked rib, optimism/flak jacket) and Puka Nacua (hip); NOT EXPECTED RJ Harvey (hamstring); EXPECTED Chris Olave (ham), Joe Burrow (back); OUT Zay Flowers (ham), Michael Pittman (foot).
items.implication: McConkey projected in with docks; Harvey opens Coleman; Flowers/Pittman clear OUT.
items.opportunity: Jonah Coleman with Harvey out; Germie Bernard with Pittman out

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps, David Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Oronde Gadsden 29-of-67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks.
items.why: In-game snap/route data with both TEs exiting early; now IR confirms.
items.implication: Gadsden clear path as primary TE with Herbert.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr down to 0.53 yards per route run this season. Only a handful of WRs worse (Johnston, Dyami Brown, Addison etc).
items.why: YPRR data through two weeks extremely low.
items.implication: Efficiency concerns despite targets; monitor for breakout or further fade.
